Join spatial posterior summaries to their polygons

Source: R/infer-spatial.R
sl_spatial_map.Rd

Join spatial posterior summaries to their polygons

Usage

sl_spatial_map(x)

Arguments

x

An sl_spatial fit.

Value

An sf object with summaries and its ingestion contract.

See also

sl_spatial_disparity()

Other inference: sl_count_model(), sl_hit_rates(), sl_simulate(), sl_spatial_disparity(), sl_veil_of_darkness()

Examples

path <- system.file("extdata", "example-spatial.rds",
  package = "searchlight"
)
if (nzchar(path)) head(sl_spatial_map(readRDS(path)))
